reviews.t: Here's how much I love JS Sloane Heavy Weight Brilliante
reviews.x: Here's how much I love JS Sloane Heavy Weight Brilliante:  Not once, but twice, I accidentally left my JS Sloane in the locker room at my gym. Both times I quickly made my way back to the locker room only to find, much to my chagrin, that it was no longer there. Luckily, because the Amazon app is so awesome, I was able to promptly purchase a new jar for myself with the swipe of a thumb. Now I am much better at remembering to take my pomade with me when I leave the gym. Thank you for asking.  The

reviews.t: This is by far the best pomade I have ever used
reviews.x: This is by far the best pomade I have ever used! I have very thick curly hair n this pomade will allow me to have a very clean combover that looks as if my hair was straight. It is more then others but it beyond worth it. The quality is there!  I use a fraction of the amount compared to other brands. I have had mine for 2 months n still have some left. It has a thick consistency, its orange/ pinkish and sparkly. It smells great and my wife loves the way it smells! It's a great product! I highly

reviews.t: Smells nice, good for everything from a slicked-back pompadour to textured, matte styles
reviews.x: Been a big fan of this stuff and have been using it for at least 6-12 months. I switched over from Shiner Gold to the JS Sloane and haven't looked back. Soft and thick from the start. Depending on how much you use, you can go from a shellac-like slick to a lightly waxed/mud texture. Love the smell, love the consistency, love the packaging.... ALWAYS BE SURE TO PUT THE LID BACK ON because the water will evaporate and you'll ruin the whole jar.

reviews.t: the best water soluble and best smelling pomade.
reviews.x: I have over 30 pomades and this is by far the best water soluble pomade on the market. Wonderful manly floral smell with great shine. The glitter in this goes so well with the las vegas casino lights it's ridiculous I was a walking disco ball. All you need is this iron society and star wax clay and you have it all the best in matte, oil, and water based pomades

reviews.t: I would definitely recommend for thick hair
reviews.x: I have ungodly thick and untamable hair, but this product gave me the hold ans shine I needed. I used this for a slick side-part, and this product kept everything in place, even after running in windy weather. No joke. This product didn't budge. I would definitely recommend for thick hair.

reviews.t: Just like the Mediumweight Brilliantine - Just a Lot Thicker Consistency
reviews.x: After using the JS Sloane Mediumweight Brilliantine for almost a year, I decided to give the Heavyweight a try. Like the Mediumweight, I feel this product smells great, and helps me achieve the style I'm going for. However it should be noted that this REALLY is heavy. At first I thought maybe try styling my hair with less of this, but regardless it was a bit more difficult to get my hair to lay flat. Also, every time I used this my hair would harden as if I was using gel. It did not maintain tha

I personally love the way that this product is easy to tease my hair with it makes my pomp with more volume than any other one an it keeps a long shine for a while and keep my hair in place and it's easy to wash out I love it and recommend It to anyone trying to get that retro look:)
On my second container. Although quite pricey, a little goes a long way. My first container lasted over a year.
A little too heavy for thinner hair but still and exceptional product

I wear my medium fine hair with a comb over pompadour and this pomade provides the best styling and scent I have found.  I have tried several other pomades from Imperial, Uppercut, and Admiral but this heavyweight is my favorite.  I find it works best with barely dry hair.  If my hair is too damp, I have to use a blow dryer to assist with lift and retention.  I am able to achieve a nice pomp with this product.  The final result is a nice shine without the wet look. reviews.t: It smells great and looks nice
reviews.x: Out of all the pomades I've used (only 4 now) this one is somewhere in the middle of the pack. It smells great and looks nice. It's got some sparkle to it which I don't mind, and can't really even see in my hair.  My hair is very thick and I have several cowlicks. I found that this pomade didn't hold up as well throughout the day as similar products like Layrite Super Hold or Steadfast Anchor Hold. What it does have going for it is that it feels less waxy and gross once it is in your hair. I als

reviews.t: It may be good for peole with thin to somewhat thick hair
reviews.x: I have thick, coarse..wavy hair.  I have REALLY thick coarse...wavy hair.  My hair is not that long, but since I have so much of it...when it starts to grow past a certain length..it can longer pomp up and slick straight the way i would want it to.  I have tried Layrite (strongest hold), Imperial (strongest hold), American crew (strongest hold), Suavecito (regular & firme/strong hold)...I've also used some Murray's but that s*** just brought the waves out even more.  JS sloan has a very strong s

reviews.t: This is the best pomade anyone could ever try
reviews.x: This is the best pomade anyone could ever try, it's so easy to apply especially in towel dry hair, it gives you hold throughout the day, it's reshape able so you just can re-style it without applying more, it wash out so easy with water and If you don't use shampoo your hair will look very conditioned, and to make things better... It has the best smell out of all the pomades I've tried and god knows I've tried a lot.

This stuff is legit! If you want to use little product with a great shine and hold this is the stuff for you!  I've used Shiner Gold and Suavacito and they don't hold a candle to the hold and shine of this product. I have thick coarse wavy hair rocking a comb over fade. This product is good enough to straighten everything out and keep the hair in place.

JS Sloane is one of my top 3 favorites for a water based pomade.  The scent is a musky, classic, old school scent.  Something like you would think your grandfather wore.  The hold is strong and lasts.  It does give you helmet head but I have not found a water based that doesn't.  A little goes a long way as well.

reviews.t: Gives your hair a good shine and holds well
reviews.x: I use this in conjunction with another wax/paste based hair product. It helps keep my hair in place and gives it a nice shine, without a greasy feel to it.
Best Pomade money can buy. Add JS Sloane Top Coat!!!

Decided to switch my hair style to a classic 'gentleman' cut and was recommended to use a pomade instead of hair wax and gel. My barber friend suggested getting JS Sloane Brilliantine. I'm giving this 5 star because it holds my hair really well and the smell of the pomade is really really nice. The texture of the pomade itself is glittery with a light pink color. Gives your hair great shine! Price wise, it is a little higher than other pomades available out there but personally, I feel the quali

Hard to find this brand nowadays. Husband use to get it at his barbers but since the guy got famous he decided to stop selling any brands other than his hown. Thank goodness amazon has it. It smells AMAZING. He and I both use it. I have thick corse hair and he has thinner hair but it works well dor both of us. Its water soluble and doesn't leave a greasy feeling on your hair.

reviews.t: ... just giving 4 starts because this is a really good quality product but It doesn't work with my type ...
reviews.x: I'm just giving 4 starts because this is a really good quality product but It doesn't work with my type of hair when the comments says It should.The smell is great. Maybe the best of all the pomades out there. It work as a cologne. It's really nice. I will keep using It for a while because I already paid for it. It's not the best hold but I can use it for some relax days.

I originally found this product via my barber 4 yrs ago and I have been using it since. I hate it when I have to use another product that's either too shiny or doesn't hold as well. I've gone to sleep, woken up and passed the brush in my hair and it goes back to its style that easily. Best hold, not obvious and smells great!

reviews.t: Love the brand but the heavyweight is a bit too ...
reviews.x: Love the brand but the heavyweight is a bit too tough and tacky. I prefer the medium weight. Very similar consistency but more hold. very shiny finish. Water based and comes out easily in shower. Smells fruity and that's a plus. For reference my hair is thick straight and black. Even this was a bit more hold than I prefer.

I love this stuff I get it for my Husabnd all the time and it keep his hair looking super fresh when rocking his hard line. On top of it I love the smell of it!!! I find my self using it when I want to do a tight slick bun :) I think we have gone through about 10 jars since finding it!!!

This stuff is great. I have really thick and heavy hair that likes to lay forward. When I use this, I can have my hair lay back and stay down. On a sidenote, I had two girls and even a guy tell me how amazing my hair smelled today.

I am on my third jar of this pomade. It smells amazing and works really well. I keep it from drying out by applying a top coat of Royal Crown. My hair is straight and styled in a tall pompadour. I absolutely recommend this pomade.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the strong hold and shine, especially for thick or hard-to-manage hair.
Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as pleasant and classic.
A little product goes a long way, though some note it is pricey.
Some reviewers find it too heavy for thinner hair or insufficient for very thick, coarse hair.
Reviewers appreciate that it washes out easily with water.
